questions.question:
D4 — Issue 1: Make Save the visible primary action?
Project/branch/task: main, Pass 1 Information Architecture, gap G1.
ELI10: Today Save, Reset, Cancel, and Export look identical in the header. A user scanning the page has to read all four labels to find the one that stores their work. DESIGN.md already says Save is the only filled button (#1d4ed8 with white text) and the other three are neutral ghost buttons. This asks whether to apply that.
Stakes if we pick wrong: users hesitate at the moment they most want confidence, and the destructive Reset sits at the same visual weight as Save.
Recommendation: 1A because it is the exact DESIGN.md token and closes the hierarchy gap with zero new vocabulary. Principle: every screen has a hierarchy; make the right choice the most visible choice.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=7/10, 1C=0/10
Net: apply the approved token now versus inventing a second weight or shipping a header with no primary action.

options.label: 1A Filled Save, ghost others (recommended)
options.description: ✅ Save becomes the single filled primary (#1d4ed8, white text); Reset/Cancel/Export become neutral ghost buttons exactly as DESIGN.md specifies ✅ Reuses the existing Button component variants, no new component (human: ~1h / CC: ~5 min) ❌ Export loses visual weight, but it stays a clearly labeled button and its position is unchanged

options.label: 1B Filled Save, outlined Export
options.description: ✅ Save still reads as primary ✅ Export gets a secondary emphasis for users who come mainly to download ❌ Adds a third button weight not in DESIGN.md and competes with Save (human: ~2h / CC: ~10 min)

options.label: 1C Defer, keep four equal buttons
options.description: ✅ No styling change this cycle ✅ Zero risk of regressing button behavior ❌ Ships the documented violation; Pass 1 stays at 6/10 and the gap remains open
